title: Emotional Support Block
description:
Emotional Support Block Mod.
Less supportive than you might expect...

But we love it all the same.
body:
**Your Minecraft World is missing something very important.**

An Emotional Support Block!

This Mod adds a single block, but it's all you need!
The Emotional Support Block will tell a very important and deep message upon being right clicked. All of the messages are 100% serious, trust me!

Over 150 unique "supportive" messages for you to enjoy!
